Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back! That was not long, as hoped. The players are in a huddle, the Proteas, that is. Out walk the West Indian openers - Evin Lewis and Andre Fletcher. Why no Chris Gayle, you ask? Because he is going to bat at number 3. This is not from this series, it has been a while now, since the decision has been taken. Big talking point - NO OVERS HAVE BEEN LOST. So West Indies have full quota of 20 overs to chase down 161. South Africa are starting with spin. George Linde will open the proceedings, to Fletcher. Here we go...

4.05 pm local (2005 GMT) - All in readiness for the second innings? Not quite. The DRIZZLE / RAIN HAS RETURNED and so have the covers. Going by the day so far, this should not last long, but fingers crossed. And just as we type that, the clouds see that and make the rain pour heavily. But there is a good breeze blowing across, so hopefully, the clouds are blown away.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then. A track which has something for the bowlers but is a good one to bat as well. Can South Africa make West Indies work for their runs? Another point of having such a big batting line-up is that the batsmen do not put a price tag on their wicket. That might see a collapse. Stay tuned for the run chase.

Fabian Allen is up for a chat. Says that the conditions are good to bowl. Add that he tried to take the wickets early and execute his plans. Further says that playing in the Pakistan Super League was good for him, but he had to transform his form at the international level as well. Ends by saying that they have a deep batting line up and are looking to chase this total down.

Who says that the Windies do not have bowlers? Think again. An excellent bowling effort from the home side. Barring Kevin Sinclair, who did not have a good day, everyone did decently for a major part of the innings. Fabian Allen was the one who started the choke and his spell of 4-0-18-2 did not allow the Proteas to breathe. Dwayne Bravo did his usual stuff towards the end. Cruically, Andre Russell bowled three overs, which is good from a West Indian point of view, given that the T20 World Cup dates are announced.

An innings which lacked momentum for the batting side. Quinton de Kock and Temba Bavuma got starts but it was Rassie van der Dussen who batted through, facing 38 balls for his 56. He took his time a bit early on but then counter-attacked later. However, there was no contribution from the middle and lower middle order. The last 5 overs yielded 46/2 but could have been more had the batters performed.

That is a decent finish for the Saffas. But would it be enough? A target of 161, against a strong batting line-up, well will require excellent bowling effort. South Africa possess a decent bowling attack but the Windies will back themselves to chase this down.

South Africa finish on 160. Full and outside off, van der Dussen drills it straight to long off, towards Pollard. There's a run-out check at the striker's end as it was a direct hit but Rabada was just in.
Length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen swings and misses.
FOUR! This is poor fielding! A short ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to square leg where Andre Fletcher lets it through and allows a boundary.
A good length ball, outside off. Rabada slashes at it but misses it. Rassie van der Dussen runs across and takes a bye as the keeper misses his shy at the striker's end.
Outside off. This is pushed to covers for a single.
Good start to the over for the Proteas. Rassie van der Dussen gets his 50 up as well. Fuller and on off. Rassie van der Dussen slogs it over mid-wicket for a biggie.

This is full and outside off, it is jammed out towards cover. They take one. The fielder could have kept it in his hand and let Rabada be on strike in the next over, but he throws it, misses the stumps at the bowler's end and they take one more. Another brilliant over from Bravo. He finishes with figures of 4-0-30-2.
FOUR! Much-needed runs for the Proteas. Full and outside off. Rabada looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge past short third man for a boundary.
No hat-trick for Bravo. On the pads. This is flicked to mid-wicket for one.
Kagiso Rabada is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two in two for Bravo and George Linde has to depart for a duck. Slower fuller ball, outside off. Linde looks to go from the first ball but ends up getting the toe end of his bat, of his attempted loft. Straight towards point where Kevin Sinclair runs back and takes a simple catch. Can Bravo take his hat-trick?
Commentary.Howout: c Kevin Sinclair b Dwayne Bravo

Commentary.Commentary: George Linde is the new man in.
OUT! CAUGHT! Fuller and angling across, outside off.  Miller slashes it flat and straight to Kieron Pollard at long off. The pressure was building and Miller had to go for the big shot.
Commentary.Howout: c Kieron Pollard b Dwayne Bravo

Commentary.Commentary: SWING AND A MISS! Fuller and slanting across the batsmen. Miller misses his drive completely.

Another slower short ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it along the ground towards square leg for a single. West Indies bowlers have used the slower balls quite effectively. Can they finish it off well too?
Yorker, on middle. Miller squeezes it out to long on for a single.
Good bowling! A good length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to chop but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller and on middle. Miller jams it to covers for a single.
A waist high full toss, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen slashes it to long of for a single. Rassie van der Dussen has a look at the square leg umpire for a waist high no-ball but nothing given.
Obed McCoy is back. His figures read 2-0-11-0.
Starts with a fuller delivery, outside off. Miller steps down and drives it to covers for one.
SIX! That is hammered!  A slower length ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen slog-pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Miller drives it to covers for one.
Fuller ball, outside off. Miller eases it to covers and collects a couple of runs.
Another slower ball, on middle. This is flicked to square leg for a single.
What an asset Bravo has in his slower delivery. A length ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen looks to heave but misses. The ball rolls over the middle stump to the keeper.
Fuller and outside off. Miller drives it to covers for a single.
Dwayne Bravo is back into the action. 2-0-12-0 so far.
SWING AND A MISS! Fuller ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks for an expansive drive but misses it completely. 8 coming off this over.
FOUT! First boundary in nearly 5 overs! A short ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it to mid-wicket and collects two.
Length ball, outside off. Miller steps down and pushes it to long off for a single.
Fullish length and around leg. David Miller looks to flick but gets a leading edge just short of mid on.
Full and on middle. This is flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Slower back of a length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to mid-wicket for a single. 5 runs and a wicket of this over.
Gets off the mark straightaway.  A full toss on middle and Miller tucks this to long on and rotates the strike.
David Miller is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jason Holder gets his man finally and Heinrich Klaasen has to depart for just 7 runs. A slower short ball, outside off. Klaasen waits for the ball to arrive and pulls it straight to Fabian Allen at square leg who takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Fabian Allen b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: Full ball, on off. Driven to long off for a single.
Fuller on middle. Flicked to mid-wicket for one,

DROPPED! A back of a length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen steps across and pulls it, gets deceived by the pace and hits it straight to the mid-wicket fielder who leaps forward but fumbles to catch it. Single taken. Kevin Sinclair is the cuplrit.
Jason Holder is back into the action. 2-0-24-0 so far.
On middle. Blocked out. 5 off the over.
Good length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Good Fielding! Fuller ball, on off. Klaasen steps a bit across and drives it wide of mid off, but Dwayne Bravo the fielder there, dives to his right and saves a boundary. Single taken.
On a length and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it through point towards sweeper cover for a single.
WIDE! Angles this one way outside off, over the tramline. Wide called.
Low full toss, on middle. Klaasen flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Angles in on length ball, outside off. Klaasen misses his drive.
Obed McCoy returns. 1-0-6-0 so far.
Slower fuller ball, on middle. Klaasen nudges it to mid-wicket for a single. Just 4 of this over.
On middle. Punched to the off side.
Another low full toss, on off. Rassie van der Dussen squeezes it to long on for a single.
Another slow dipping full toss, on middle and leg. Klaasen flicks it to on side for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Klaasen punches it to covers for nothing.
Slower good length ball, on the pads. This is flicked to square leg for a single.
Fraction short, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it to the point fielder for a quick single. 5 runs and a wicket of Temba Bavuma from this over. Fabian Allen finishes with figures of 4-0-18-2.
Flatter, outside off. Heinrich Klaasen pushes it on the off side and takes a single.
Fullish length, on middle. Driven to long on for a single.
Gets underway by pushing this length ball towards covers for one.
On middle. Rassie van der Dussen dances down and tucks it to long on for a single.
Heinrich Klaasen is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fabian Allen has removed the opposition captain. Tossed up, on middle. Temba Bavuma gets on knee and looks to slog it over mid-wicket. Gets the required elevation but not the distance. Hits it straight in the hands of Evin Lewis at deep mid-wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Evin Lewis b Fabian Allen

Commentary.Commentary: Fabian Allen is back into the action. 3-0-13-1 so far.
FOUR! Not a good end from Dwayne Bravo! Full toss, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it to square leg for a boundary.
A low dipping full toss, on middle. Bavuma sqeezes it to long on for a single.
Another slower fuller ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen paddles it to square leg for a single.
LEG BYE! Fuller length ball, on middle and leg. Temba Bavuma looks to heave it but misses it. The ball rolls to the off side and a single is taken.
Slower fuller ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen digs it out to mid on for a single.
Slower length ball, on middle. Temba Bavuma flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Dwayne Bravo is into the action replacing Andre Russell.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
A slower ball, outside off, tapped towards point.
Around off, short in length, nudged through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! It is a cheeky one this one. A length ball, outside off, slower in pace, Bavuma gets across and laps it over the keeper.
Outside off, Bavuma taps it towards point and sets off for a single. But the point fielder quickly gets to the ball and the run is averted.
There comes the hard length which this guy is so famous for and Ian Bishop goes ga ga over him. Outside off, Rassie van der Dussen steers it through point for a single.
Obed McCoy to bowl now.
Fuller, around off, worked around mid-wicket for a couple. 12 from the over, Andre Russell's figures read 2-0-21-1.
FOUR! A short ball, outside off, Temba Bavuma pulls it to the mid-wicket fence.

Let's use this opportunity to analyze the Proteas innings. A quickfire start it was but then a couple of wickets pegged them back. Quinton de Kock was the main aggresor but Russell dismissing him has kind of pushed the visitors back. Ahhh... here we go. PLAY ABOUT TO RESUME!

RAIN STOPPAGE AGAIN - 2.49 pm local (1849 GMT) - This is frustrating. One of the days where drizzle is not light enough to allow play but not heavy and long enough to keep players indoors. Seems to be a start-stop passage. West Indies will not mind this, but South Africa will get irritated. Oh yes and they are yet to be friends with Duckworth-Lewis-Stern.
Fuller ball, way outside off. Temba Bavuma looks to push but misses it.
Back of a length ball, on middle. Pulled to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Well Played! A length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen opens his bat face and guides it to the third man fence for a boundary.
Length on middle. Tucked to mid on for a single.
On middle. Flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Again the reverse sweep comes out! On middle. Temba Bavuma reverse sweep it towards short third man for a single.
On middle. Temba Bavuma plays the reverse sweep towards short third man for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen dabs it to short third man for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Temba Bavuma pushes it to the off side for a single.
Hurrah! Reminds me of my childhood where we used to stop play to go home and drink a glass of water. It is that type of a scenario. The players are back on the field! Let's resume then.

RAIN STOPPAGE - 2.35 pm local (1830 GMT) - This was coming. The heavens have opened up and the players are rushing off for cover. The pitch and a couple of squares are covered but looks like a passing shower.

LEG BYE! Tossed up, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen gets on knee and looks to paddle sweep but misses. West Indies appeal for LBW, but the umpire is unmoved. Allen walks to Pollard and suggests to take the review. Pollard shows the 'T' sign. UltraEdge confirms no bat. Ball Tracking shows wickets missing and the review is lost.
Review has been taken for LBW! Ball Tracking shows wickets missing and West Indies lose their review.
SWING AND A MISS! A good length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma looks to slash it but misses.
Short ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen gets on top of the bounce and pulls it to square leg for a single, he is off the mark straightaway.
Rassie van der Dussen is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! DRE RUSS STRIKES! Removes the man in form. A fullish length ball, on middle. Quinton de Kock looks to drive it over mid on but gets toe end of the bat, straight to Jason Holder at mid on who takes a good low diving catch to dismiss Quinton de Kock on 37.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Holder b Andre Russell

Commentary.Commentary: Calls for two and gets it with ease! Full ball, on off. Quinton de Kock steps down and flicks it to mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs.
SIX! He is in such a fine form, that he is making batting look so easy. Fullish length, on leg. Quinton de Kock rocks back and whacks it over square leg for a biggie. Moves to 35 in no time.
Length ball, on middle. Quinton de Kock pushes it back to the bowler.
Andre Russell is into the attack.
Loopy ball, on leg. Quinton de Kock pulls it to mid-wicket for a single. End of the Powerplay, South Africa are 53/1.
Flatter, on middle. Bevuma pushes it on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Well Played! Fracton short, on middle. Temba Bavuma pulls it to mid-wicket for a boundary.
Overpitches it on middle. Temba Bavuma paddles it to short fine leg.
Darted on the pads. Quinton de Kock tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Blocked out.
Full, on middle. This is driven to mid on for a single.
SIX! Bang! Full and outside off. Quinton de Kock steps across and heaves it over mid-wicket for a six.

Chance, better throw and Quinton de Kock was a goner! Outside off, on a length. de Kock cuts it past point. Third man runs across and throws the ball towards the striker's end where the keeper misses a hard chance to run Quinton de Kock out.
Fuller ball, on off. Driven to the point fielder.
FOUR! Innovative! Low dipping full toss, outside off. Quinton de Kock steps across on the off side and paddle scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Full and outside off. Quinton de Kock swings and misses it.
Jason Holder comes back into the attack.
On middle. Temba Bavuma dead-bats it. Good over from Fabian Allen - one run and a wicket.

Appeal but turned down! Fuller and on middle and leg. Temba Bavuma looks to paddle it but misses. Gets hit on the pads. West Indies appeal but it is turned down. UltraEdge shows there was some glove. Good decision not to review.
The skipper, Temba Bavuma, is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! West Indies get their breakthrough! Flatter and quicker, on middle. Reeza Hendricks steps down and looks to slash it but looks to play outside the line. The ball rolls through the big gab between bat and pad and clips the off stump out.
On middle. Reeza Hendricks pushes it to the off side.
Flatter, on off. Quinton de Kock slogs it to square leg for a single
Floated delivery, on middle. Quinton de Kock looks to paddle but gets hit on the pads, the ball rolls over in the air and drops near his pads.
Fabian Allen is into the action now.
Darted on the pads. This is flicked straight to mid-wicket. 17 off the over.
WIDE! Spills it down the leg side. Wide called.
FOUR! Good Placement! Fraction short, outside off. Reeza Hendricks cuts it through cover-point for four.
SIX! First six of the innings! Loopy ball, on off. Reeza Hendricks steps down and smokes it over long off for a biggie.
Flatter and outside off. de Kock cuts it to point who dives to his left and saves some runs for his team. Single taken.
Tossed up, on middle. Hendricks pushes it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Good Shot! Overpitches it outside off. Reeza Hendricks slashes it over covers for a boundary.
Full ball, on middle. Reeza Hendricks flicks it to square leg and gets underway. 11 of the over.
Length ball, outside off. de Kock cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! First of the innings! A fuller ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock steps across and drives it past mid off for a boundary.
Couple more!  A fuller delivery, outside off. Quinton de Kock drives it uppishly over covers for two.
A back of a length ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock cuts it past point towards third man for a couple of runs.
WIDE! Angles this one on a fuller length, over the tramline. Quinton de Kock looks to drive but misses. Wide called.
SWING AND A MISS! Fuller ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock looks to drive but misses it completely.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Jason Holder.
On middle. This is flicked to mid-wicket for a single. Decent start by Kevin Sinclair.
Lopy ball, on middle. Quinton de Kock gets on a knee and paddles it over short fine leg for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, on middle. Quinton de Kock blocks it out.
South Africa and Reeza Hendricks are underway! Tossed up delivery, on middle. Hendricks clips it to mid-wicket and runs for a single.
Another loopy ball, on middle. Defended out.
Starts with a flatter ball, on the pads. Reeza Hendricks clips it to square leg.
The players are out on the field. Reeza Hendricks and Quinton de Kock are the openers for South Africa. Kevin Sinclair will open the bowling for the hosts. Hendricks to face. Here we go then...

South African captain, Temba Bavuma, says they wanted to bowl too. Adds there is a strong sense of confidence within the guys and they need the guys playing the T20s to carry on the good work by the Test team. States the first couple of months was about experimenting and now, it is a lot more clear about who they want to pick and it is a good chance for his side to show their skills.

West Indian skipper, Kieron Pollard, says that with the weather and with the new guys around, bowling first seems like a good choice. Adds that this has been a good wicket for batting over the years and they will look to have a proper plan as to how to chase this down.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Reeza Hendricks, Temba Bavuma (C), Rassie van der Dussen, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, George Linde, Kagiso Rabada, Anrich Nortje, Tabraiz Shamsi and Lungi Ngidi.
West Indies (Playing XI) - Evin Lewis, Andre Fletcher, Chris Gayle, Nicholas Pooran (WK), Kieron Pollard (C), Andre Russell, Jason Holder, Dwayne Bravo, Fabian Allen, Obed McCoy and Kevin Sinclair.

TOSS - The flip of the coin is done. Kieron Pollard has won the toss and WEST INDIES HAVE ELECTED TO CHASE. Not surprising, since there is rain around the horizon and also, they are traditionally better chasers.

Update from another part of the world - This is North America. A cricket match has just ended in the continent of Europe where England have trounced Sri Lanka by 88 runs to whitewash them 3-0 in a T20I series. It was an absolute no match with Sri Lanka simply not turning up. Hopefully this match gives us some entertainment.

How is the weather? The first thing to be checked. Thunderstorms were forecast during the morning and hopefully, we shall have the game start on time. Just had a look at the ground pictures. The sun is shining brightly but there are dark clouds on the horizon.

Hello and warm welcome to the coverage of the first T20I game between West Indies and South Africa. The home side would look to shrug the defeat they suffered in the red-ball series, as now they compete in a format which they are well-known for. On the other hand, the Porteas with a stronger bowling line up, would look to continue their domination away from their home soil. It is going to a thrilling encounter, no doubt about that. Can the West Indies start on a positive note? Or will South Africa upset them yet again? We shall find out soon. Stay tuned for toss and more updates.
